ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial transactions and connections between state officials and individuals or organizations involved in fraudulent activities.
questions: What financial transactions are connected to the alleged ICE obstruction?
Are there any other fraudulent activities in the state that are connected to the officials being investigated?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover a larger pattern of corruption and wrongdoing in the state. This could involve analyzing financial records and transactions to identify any suspicious activity.
